title: 第26章 药剂第27章 城里城外
content_zh:
47%。
陈冲看着眼前的数字，想着
“进度一般般。越变越慢，感觉食堂的东西是吃‘腻’了。”
食堂的饭菜无论口味和营养自然只是普通，胜在量大而已，实在吃不够还能用营养膏来凑。
不过一日三餐还是最主要的来源，陈冲准备给食堂充一笔钱，换些更好食材的份额。
但这笔钱最重要的去处，他已经有了主意。
按着于峰的指引，陈冲来到了园区的医务室，是在拳手小楼西边两百多米的一座平房。
“哪不舒服？”
戴着口罩的中年男医生问道。
他的气质和陈冲在城里医院见到的医生别无二致，陈冲看了他两眼，道
“没不舒服，我来买补剂。e-2有么？”
“哦，有的。”
医生来了兴致，就要去柜台后面拿药。
“等一下，我再看下清单吧。”
陈冲打断了他，接过一张塑封彩印清单，上面列着一列的营养补剂，还有图文介绍。
于峰是直接推荐他用e-2，但陈冲想先瞅一眼。
“e系列营养补剂，曙光生物公司研发的基础营养剂，能够极大的提高免疫力，提升代谢效率，增进器官功能，增强肌肉束强度……”
一堆宣传用语，最后来到关键
“适合进入境界前的格斗者使用，可以加速骨骼强化进度。”
然后是e-1到e-4，效果依次增加，不过e-3和e-4这里都没有货，就算有陈冲也买不起。

那是e系列的高端品，至少五位数，城里也是供不应求。
陈冲又扫了眼其他的药剂，大多数都是曙光生物的产品。
能够增强视力的“光明”系列，激活身高二次发育的“大树”系列，甚至**淬炼全面促进、对高境界格斗者也有效的a系列……
大部分都没货，毕竟这里也不是什么大药店。
陈冲扫了过去，的确是e-2最适合自己。
只有饮剂，内部价6800元一支，十毫升。
陈冲掏钱买下，拿到那支手指长的细棕瓶之后，看了看，将其收好，然后快步离开。
回到自己的宿舍，陈冲将门关好，再次取出营养补剂。
生物公司的营养补剂，在这个世界几乎是格斗者想要往上攀登不可缺少的东西。
不过说起来高明，实际和健身用的蛋白粉、传统武术用的药散丹丸并无本质区别，都是补充增强身体所需，只是形式上的差异而已。
而饮剂类的营养补剂就连形式上的区别也没有了。
但这毕竟是现代科技——或者说中心城科技的东西。这种东西在荒原上流通的，到底是真货假货？是不是以次充好？都很难说得清。
哪怕雷龙是个大园区，也曾有拳手买到假药，用过就暴毙的。
小概率事件，但不是没有。而且暴毙的几率低，副作用的几率却很高，这导致许多拳手对这类补剂心有抵触。
不过陈冲是无所谓的。
大不了喝了没效果，他相信自己的消化能力。
甚至只要不是白水兑的，多少对他都有点用。
“营养补剂，对我来说不只是让境界提升。这里面蕴含的能量非常高吧？”
陈冲有些期待。这一剂让他钱包扁扁的口服液，不知道能让天赋进步多少呢？
第一形态的强大彻底改变了他的处境，他对第二形态期待已久。

他不再等待，将瓶口拧开，仰头一饮而尽。
……
“张哥，有消息了吗？”
利川，139厂职工宿舍，沈家。
沈建平拿着话筒，对着那边低声问道。
content_en:
47%.
Chen Chong looked at the numbers in front of him and thought
"The progress is so-so. It's getting slower and slower. I feel like I'm getting tired of the food in the cafeteria."
The food in the cafeteria is of course average in terms of taste and nutrition, but it's just that it's large in quantity. If you really don't have enough, you can use nutritional paste to make up for it.
However, three meals a day are still the main source. Chen Chong is going to charge a sum of money to the canteen in exchange for a share of better ingredients.
But he already had an idea about where the money should go.
Following Yu Feng's guidance, Chen Chong came to the infirmary in the park, which was a bungalow more than 200 meters west of the boxer's building.
"What's uncomfortable?"
asked the middle-aged male doctor wearing a mask.
His temperament was no different from the doctor Chen Chong saw in the city hospital. Chen Chong looked at him twice and said
"I'm not feeling uncomfortable. I'm here to buy supplements. Do you have e-2?"
"Oh, yes."
When the doctor gets interested, he goes behind the counter to get medicine.
"Wait a minute, let me look at the list again."
Chen Chong interrupted him and took over a plastic-sealed and color-printed list, which listed a list of nutritional supplements and introduced them with pictures and texts.
Yu Feng directly recommended him to use e-2, but Chen Chong wanted to take a look first.
"The e-series nutritional supplements, the basic nutritional supplements developed by Shuguang Biological Company, can greatly improve immunity, improve metabolic efficiency, enhance organ function, and enhance muscle strength..."
A bunch of promotional phrases, finally coming to the key
"It is suitable for use by fighters before entering the realm. It can accelerate the progress of bone strengthening."
Then there are e-1 to e-4, and the effects increase in sequence. However, e-3 and e-4 are not available here, and even Chen Chong cannot afford them.
It was a high-end e-series product, worth at least five figures, and demand in the city exceeded supply.
Chen Chong glanced at the other potions, most of which were products of Dawn Biotech.
The "Light" series that can enhance eyesight, the "Big Tree" series that activates secondary height growth, and even the A series that comprehensively promotes body tempering and is also effective for high-level fighters...
Most of them are out of stock, after all, this is not a big pharmacy.
Chen Chong scanned it and realized that e-2 was indeed the most suitable for him.
There is only a drink, the internal price is 6,800 yuan per bottle, 10 ml.
Chen Chong paid for it. After getting the finger-long thin brown bottle, he looked at it, put it away, and left quickly.
Returning to his dormitory, Chen Chong closed the door and took out the nutritional supplements again.
Nutritional supplements from biological companies are almost indispensable in this world for fighters who want to climb up.
However, it sounds clever, but in reality there is no essential difference between protein powder used for fitness and medicinal powder pills used in traditional martial arts. They are all supplements to strengthen the body, and they are just different in form.
As for beverage nutritional supplements, there is no difference in form.
But this is modern technology after all - or Central City technology. Is this kind of thing circulating in the wasteland genuine or fake? Is it a shoddy product? It's hard to tell clearly.
Even though Brontosaurus is a large park, there have been cases where boxers bought fake medicine and died suddenly after using it.
A small probability event, but not impossible. Moreover, the probability of sudden death is low, but the probability of side effects is high, which makes many boxers resistant to this type of supplement.
But Chen Chong didn't care.
At worst, drinking it would have no effect. He believed in his digestion ability.
Even if it is not mixed with plain water, it will be of some use to him.
"Nutritional supplements, for me, don't just improve my realm. The energy contained in them is very high, right?"
Chen Chong was looking forward to it. I wonder how much this oral liquid, which makes his wallet a little thin, can improve his talent?
The power of the first form completely changed his situation, and he had been looking forward to the second form for a long time.
He no longer waited, unscrewed the bottle's mouth, raised his head and drank it in one gulp.
…
